name: wazir
description: Wazir is a model- and runtime-agnostic meta-harness that schedules AI agents, models, tools, and compute to execute tasks across local and distributed environments.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run bundle
scripts.test:tui: npm run build && vitest run apps/cli/tests/fleetTui.test.ts apps/cli/tests/tuiSessionLifecycle.test.ts apps/cli/tests/fleetRunner.e2e.test.ts apps/cli/tests/spinner.test.ts apps/cli/tests/doctor.test.ts apps/cli/tests/executeTask.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:agent: npm run build && vitest run packages/agents/tests/codingAgent.turnTimeout.test.ts packages/agents/tests/codingAgent.proseBailout.test.ts packages/agents/tests/codingAgent.circuitBreaker.test.ts packages/agents/tests/codingAgent.contextCompaction.test.ts packages/agents/tests/codingAgent.maxTurns.test.ts packages/agents/tests/parseAction.test.ts packages/core/tests/jobOrchestrator.test.ts packages/core/tests/jobLifecycleAndValidation.test.ts packages/core/tests/policyEngineShell.test.ts packages/core/tests/policyEngineHardening.test.ts packages/tools/tests/sandbox.test.ts apps/cli/tests/fleetTui.test.ts
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['packages','apps'])for(const p of fs.readdirSync(d))for(const s of ['dist','node_modules']){const t=d+'/'+p+'/'+s;try{fs.rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}}"
